description: Use this when the user wants Markdown or plain text (a chat answer, notes, a report, a README) as a downloadable PDF and an editable Word (DOCX) file. Reads ATX headings 1-4, paragraphs, bold, italic, inline code, fenced code blocks, bullet and numbered lists (2 levels), pipe tables, links, block quotes and rules; other Markdown prints as plain text and is listed in notes. Options: Letter or A4, normal or narrow margins, 10-14 pt text, title page, contents page, page numbers. Returns both links, the page count, the outline with page numbers, and a read-back check of the PDF text. Does not write or edit content, embed images, or convert existing files (Word, HTML, scans). Links expire in about 1 hour.

font_size.description: Body text size in points from 10 to 14, e.g. 11 (default).

format.description: markdown (default) reads # headings, lists, tables and so on; plain prints the text as paragraphs with no markup.

margins.description: Page margins: normal (1 in / 25.4 mm, default) or narrow (0.5 in / 12.7 mm).

page_numbers.description: true (default) prints "page / total" at the bottom of each page except a title page.

paper.description: Paper size: letter (US, default) or a4.

table_of_contents.description: true to add a contents page listing headings of levels 1-3 with their page numbers. Default false.

text.description:
The Markdown or plain text to typeset, up to 200,000 characters, e.g. "# Trip notes

- Day 1: Lisbon
- Day 2: Porto".

title.description: Optional document title printed at the top (or on a title page), e.g. "Q3 Field Report". Up to 200 characters.

title_page.description: true to print the title on its own first page. Needs a title (or uses the first heading). Default false.

name: make_pdf
title: Make PDF and Word file
